IGUI_BardToTheBone_Info:
The Bard to the Bone music system utilizes ABC notation.
To turn MIDI files into songs, open the gear menu and press Song Guide for the guide and conversion tools.
IGUI_BardToTheBone_ColumnLevel_tooltip: Song difficulty for the instrument in your hands. Green is at or below your skill, red is well above it. Sort by difficulty.
IGUI_BardToTheBone_SongGuide_tooltip: Opens the mod's GitHub page: the song guide, plus tools for converting MIDI files to ABC.
IGUI_BardToTheBone_VoiceTooltip: Pick which part of the song to play, or All for every part.
IGUI_BardToTheBone_NeedsAmp: Needs a powered guitar amplifier nearby.
IGUI_BardToTheBone_MuteInstruments_toolt: Silences every instrument you hear, yours and other players'. Zombies can still hear them.
IGUI_perks_BardStrings_Description: Reduces mistakes when playing string instruments: guitars, bass, banjo and violin. Trained by playing them.
IGUI_perks_BardKeys_Description: Reduces mistakes when playing keyboard instruments: pianos and keytar. Trained by playing them.
IGUI_perks_BardWinds_Description: Reduces mistakes when playing wind instruments: flute, saxophone, trumpet, harmonica, whistles and bottles. Trained by playing them.
IGUI_perks_BardPercussion_Description: Reduces mistakes when playing percussion instruments: drums and xylophone. Trained by playing them.
